description: Create or change a scheduled task on an app. Omit task_id to create; pass it to edit, and any field left out keeps its current value. Two kinds: `http` requests a PATH ON THE APP ITSELF (the common case — `/cron.php` for Nextcloud, `/wp-cron.php` for WordPress) and counts 2xx/3xx as success; `command` runs a shell command in an image you name, on the app's network. The request reaches the app at its own address inside the server, so it works even for an app with no public hostname. Cadence is a fixed set, not a cron expression. Nothing runs inside the app's own container — that needs root on the host, which is deliberately not offered.

command.description: Single-line shell command, no double quotes. command kind only.

deployment_id.description: The dpl_... id the task belongs to.

enabled.description: Set false to pause without deleting.

http_path.description: Path on the app, starting with / — e.g. /cron.php.

keep_runs.description: How many past runs to keep, 1-200. Default 10.

name.description: What this task is for, in a few words.

task_id.description: Omit to create; pass to edit.

name: impreza_schedule_task
